messages:
kevin: Quick sync — where are we on the prefetch/hot-kv hook? need clear owner + PR review so we can hit the v1.3 perf sprint milestone (end of week).
anya: Prefetch PR is green on unit/integration, still waiting for infra flag before merging. left perf numbers in the PR description.
dina: I can take the review tonight, ping me with the link. small items only?
ravi: blocked on infra: we need a mem-protection flag to avoid eviction thrash on hosts. I filed INF-432 but need eng-infra to pick it up.
samir: FYI saw a small tail increase (~8%) on long-seq tests in staging when prefetch was enabled without the mem guard. looks like eviction + prefetch jitter.
anya: PR link: https://github.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/2897 — config snippet below:
```
kv.prefetch.enabled = true
kv.eviction.threshold = 0.65
kv.prefetch.max_prefetch = 4
```
please check thresholds.
dina: saw a flake in kv_warmup_test related to timing, I'll push a tiny test timeout bump and re-run.
ci-bot: Build #2897.3 passed after re-run (2 flaky tests fixed). :white_check_mark:
kevin: Action items: (1) dina to finish CR by 22:00 PT, (2) eng-infra to add mem-protection flag INF-432 by EOD, (3) samir to re-run full perf matrix after flag lands, (4) anya to coordinate a conservative canary.
ravi: INF-432 created: https://jira.internal/INF-432 assigned to @marta (eng-infra). added notes about kernel pages and memory cgroup.
marta: taking INF-432, ETA 18:00 PT. Will add `kv.mem_protect=true` toggled via feature-flags service and make default off.
samir: I'll run the staging perf sweep after 18:30 and post numbers to the thread. plan: long-seq lat tail, p50/p95/p99, and cpu/gpu util.
anya: Canary plan: 20:00 PT, 10% traffic, 30m observation window, auto-rollback on p99 > baseline * 1.05 or error rate spike. @kevin confirm?
kevin: Confirmed. rollback on p99 > 1.05 or any error increase > 0.5%. also abort if memory OOMs observed.
dina: CR done, left two nits. will merge after mem_protect flag exists and CI passes.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled at 20:00 PT for runtime-instance-group "prefetch-canary" (10% traffic).
kevin: Thanks — I'll update the sprint board (card v1.3 -> in-canary) and create a short postmortem template in case we need rollback notes.
anya: Will post canary results + perf tables here. if anyone wants to pair on quick perf dig after roll, ping me. :coffee:
kevin: Great. Last ask: owners, add a one-line status to the sprint ticket when you finish your action so PMs have visibility.
